name: Drill ad-lib stabs
desc: Dark UK/NY drill ad-libs — pitched-down 'yeah', 'ades' and speech stabs machine-placed off the grid over a slow half-time feel. Sparse drops two menacing stabs per cycle under a low filter breath; full scatters more with a higher speed-up echo canon and every-4 double-time flurries; peak jux-mirrors a denser reversed-and-forward barrage. Unpitched, sparse, sinister — the space between the hits does the threatening.

code.full: s("~ yeah:5 ~ ~ ades2 ~ ~ speech:2 ~ ~ yeah:8 ~ ades2 ~ ~ yeah:3").speed("<.8 .7 .9 .75 .85>").shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).off(1/8, x=>x.speed(1.5).gain(.35).lpf(2200)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.28).delay(${send}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.4).orbit(8).play()
